framing: Fueling / performance only — never weight or deficit (D64).

lead.pre_day: Carb-forward meal ~2–3 h before; ~1 g/kg carbohydrate pre-session; avoid a high-GI spike immediately before (spike-crash → flat).

during_by_duration.short: ≤90 min: water is sufficient; no sports-drink benefit.
during_by_duration.long: >90 min: low-GI fuel (balanced 40:30:30 bars, fruit, fructose/protein drink); sip ~240 ml every 1–2 h; optional creatine 2–5 g (never load).

lead.hydration_by_climate: Pre-hydrate ~500 ml. ~1–2 quarts / 8 h normal, 3–4 quarts on a hot day. A 1.5% body-weight fluid loss measurably cuts max strength and raises joint/tendon injury risk. Prioritize electrolytes on long/hot days.
lead.caffeine_timing: Time ~45–60 min before the key burn; periodize to avoid tolerance.
lead.post_day: High-GI carb + protein within ~2 h (~4:1 carb:protein, ~0.3 g/kg protein); rehydrate. Sleep is the #1 recovery tool.

climate_addons.precool: In heat: ~1 L cold (~4 °C) drink or a slushie pre/mid-session lowers core temperature and prolongs heat tolerance.

day_type_nuances.project: Use the long rests to refuel/rehydrate; low-GI to hold energy across the long day (brief maximal bursts).
day_type_nuances.volume: Steady carb intake; higher fluid/electrolyte need (sustained continuous output).
